ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’)
ἐόντι: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὄντι): ’being’
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hearken to (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), in a general statement: ’they hear’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’
ἔνδυνε: ἐνδύω (ἐνδύνω) — put on (clothing); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented ἔνδυνε (= ἐνέδυνε): ’put on’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρρεξε: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 3 sg.
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἕθεν: ἕ, οὗ — of himself, him, her; 3 sg. pron., gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ); with πρόσθεν, πρό: ’in front of him’, reflexive ’in front of himself’ · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from himself’ (ἀπὸ ἕθεν … ὤσατο ’pushed away from himself’)
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.: ’each (man)’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg.: ’a single’ (ἕνα μῆνα ’a single month’); ’one’ (ἕνα καὶ δύο ’one and two’)
ἠέ: ἠέ — than (after a comparative); epic form of ἤ · also ἠέ = ἦε, ’or’, introducing a second question
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠϋκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος (= ἐΰκομος) — fair-haired; adj. of two endings, fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with Βρισηΐδος · also agreeing with Ἑλένης: ’fair-haired (Helen)’ · also agreeing with Θέτιδος: ’fair-haired (Thetis)’ · also agreeing with Ἀθηναίης: ’fair-haired (Athena)’
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’)
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I came’ · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they came, advanced’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰλιόθι: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; ἰλιόθι, locative adv. with suffix -θι: ’at Ilios’
ἱερὸν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. acc. sg. (the neut. has the same spelling)
ἱκάνει: ἱκάνω — come, arrive, reach; pres. 3 sg.
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a past general relative clause: ’whom he might see’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. after μή, in a negative purpose clause: ’lest he see’ (μή μιν ἴδοι ’lest he see her’)
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg.: ’sent’
ὀπάων: ὀπάων — attendant, companion in arms; masc. nom. sg.
ὀρώρῃ: ὄρνυμι — rouse, set in motion; perf. subj. 3 sg. (of ὄρωρα ’have risen, am stirred’), intrans.: ’be stirring’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄμβρον: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
